name: cockpit
description: Usage cockpit: one small Usage button above the prompt that expands to one line per item (context, 5h and 7d limits, cost, cache, model fit) with progress bars, pixel crab icons whose mood follows each bar and what uses your tokens; a free model and effort advisor; a budget guard with Compact and Handoff; /handoff notes; /usage-panel.

warnPercent.title: Warning level (%)
warnPercent.description: Orange bars, a toast and the sweating crab from this percent (yellow starts at 50%)

criticalPercent.title: Critical level (%)
criticalPercent.description: Red bars, the angry crab, and Compact now and Handoff buttons past this percent

costBudgetUsd.title: Session cost budget (USD)
costBudgetUsd.description: The cost bar is full at this amount

advisor.title: Model and effort advisor
advisor.description: Suggest a model and effort for each prompt with a free scored classifier (no model call): English, French and Arabic signals, sticky for follow-ups

advisorAi.title: Advisor: AI check when unsure
advisorAi.description: Off by default. When on and the rule score is ambiguous, one Haiku call at low effort classifies the prompt; its cost shows on the model line

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: the TTL the engine reports on a model switch, else 1h on a subscription and 5m otherwise

keepAlive.title: Cache keep-alive pings
keepAlive.description: Off by default. When on, a tiny fork reads the cached conversation shortly before the TTL ends, which refreshes it. Each ping costs a cache read of the whole context

keepAliveMaxPings.title: Keep-alive: most pings per idle period
keepAliveMaxPings.description: Pings between two of your turns, at most

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr or ar (right to left)

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: Log the origin kind and length of each prompt submission, and whether it was advised
